title: PCSO fulfills Marcos’ vow to back healthcare in Pangasinan town

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) turned over on Tuesday medical equipment, medicines, and a patient transport vehicle to the Santa Barbara Infirmary in Pangasinan, fulfilling the promise of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to support the town’s public healthcare needs. In his recorded message, Marcos announced the delivery of the equipment, as requested by Santa Barbara Mayor Carlito S. Zaplan for the municipality’s medical facilities, saying, “I’m very happy to announce to our friends in Santa Barbara, Pangasinan, that the equipment that was requested for your medical facilities has already been approved and will be provided by the […]...
